en: <CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>A <CLT=cltSTRONG>body discovery announcement<CLT=cltMIND>...
means the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltMIND> is still alive...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...I still...don't believe...
That Kaito...is dead.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no point in announcements anymore.
Everything is...over.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>So Kokichi was the one really
behind all those announcements.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps I'll never get used to these after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't remember there being any
mysterious objects here. I'll look elsewhere.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone must be in the dining hall...
I should go too.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki gave me an invite... I should go
to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin's lab<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure everyone is gathered
in the dining hall. I should go too.

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway...I should head to the gym.
I'm sure everyone is gathered there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone went to the underground passage.
I should hurry and meet them.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should go to the dining hall for now...
<CLT=cltMIND>I should see how Kaito is doing...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure he doesn't want me to worry
about him, but...I have to.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should go to the dining hall first!
Everyone should be there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone should be in the hangar.
I should go too.

<CLT=cltMIND>To live... To find a reason to live...
so that everyone's deaths weren't for nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were supposed to stop Kokichi,
and end the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>So why...?
Why did this happen...?
<CLT=cltMIND>...This doesn't have anything to do with the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>I only have a limited time to investigate.
I can't get distracted.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's still time...
I should head back to the hangar.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps I missed something...
I should check again.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should head to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Shrine of Judgment<CLT=cltMIND>
in the courtyard.
